The line before carries `// eslint-disable-next-line jest/no-focused-tests`, which names another plugin's rule, so ESLint reports the `test.only`. The port carries `suppress.oxlint` `no-focused-tests` (Oxlint 1.88.0 implements it, reads `eslint-disable` comments and matches a directive name with a `/` by its part after the last `/`), so the comment silences it as it silences Oxlint, by design (docs/pack-format.md, check 4). Without the comment the port reports the `test.only`, as ESLint does.
